result.title: NativeSeg: Native Vision Language Segmentation of 3D Computed Tomography via Spatial Visual Tokens and Verified Local Zoom
result.comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/step-out/NativeSeg ; Weights: https://huggingface.co/ChengqianMa/NativeSeg
result.summary: Text prompted 3D computed tomography (CT) segmentation requires both full slice context and fine boundary precision across volumes where over $80\%$ of organ prompted slices lack the queried target. Existing medical vision language models (VLMs) are largely non native segmenters: they delegate pixel delineation outside the VLM by compressing reasoning into a 1D [SEG] vector for an external Segment Anything Model (SAM) decoder, quantizing masks into lossy discrete codebooks, or issuing box prompts to stateless external SAM tools without empty slice screening or spatial state memory. We introduce NativeSeg, a native vision language segmentation framework on Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapted Qwen3.8-27B that performs dense mask decoding, volumetric triage, spatial error self diagnosis, and multiround local zoom directly over the VLM's 2D spatial visual tokens without external SAM decoders. NativeSeg decodes confidence maps from upper layer 2D spatial tokens fused with a five slice U-Net pathway, halts at zero zooms on $>91\%$ of standalone evaluations via a native presence gate (<pres>), localizes uncertain boundaries via a 20 cell multiscale error gate (<err>), and accepts zoomed updates only when predicted error decreases. Trained solely on adult CT, NativeSeg improves Round $0$ DSC by $+19.81$ and $+7.04$ points over discrete codebook and 1D [SEG] readouts on the identical backbone, reaches $86.81\%$ adult and $87.04\%$ zero shot pediatric DSC, and safely refines 2D nnU-Net ($89.52\%$ adult; $86.86\%$ pediatric), 3D SegVol ($86.81\%$), and 3D VoxTell ($89.85\%$).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 NativeSeg，在 LoRA 微调的 Qwen 上直接由上层二维空间视觉 token 融合五切片 U-Net 通路解码 3D CT 稠密掩码，并用 presence gate 判空、误差门控定位边界、仅在预测误差下降时接受多轮局部放大。
AI.relevance_reason: 其明确以空间 token 读取代替 [SEG] 向量与离散码本，可供核查视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题；判空提前停止与「误差下降才接受更新」的验证式放大，则对应 LOOK/STOP 的触发条件、支持组合与收益—成本权衡。
